The average strongly held belief these days in AI has a half life of 6 months at best. Here are just a few the industry has cycled through and probably has no consensus on at the moment:

* OSS is too far behind to catch up 

* The labs can’t be profitable at scale

* All software will be replaced by agents

* You can’t build moats on top of models

* Cheaper models will mean less compute

* You don’t need evals

* RAG is dead 

* AI will decimate engineering jobs

* Prompting won’t matter in the future 

* We’ve hit a training wall

* Frontier models are too dangerous to release 

…and dozens and dozens more. The key here is to remain flexible in your thinking because we’re going to be in a constant state of change for a while.

tweets.text:
AI product building has a ~3-month playbook half-life. Here’s how to adapt.

Most trad product teams are built to discover a playbook and then milk it for the next 5 years.

However in the AI labs, we consciously throw away playbooks every few months cos we start seeing diminishing returns.

Here’s what you can do as an AI builder:

Focus on defining a set of meta-principles for 
1/ how you continuously learn what the market wants today and what it might want in 3 months
2/ how you execute with extreme urgency

The specifics of 1 and 2 will vary based on your domain and product type.
Build a team that learns and adapts at that pace. 

Legacy teams are optimized for playbook milking.

AI teams need to be optimized for inventing.

tweets.text: David Mattin and I write about whats on the other side of the Singularity every week at The Exponentialist. Sign up here... https://t.co/8ZLZCY6EXx

We’re seeing the ramping of the agent economy. A new population... still early, still mostly directed by humans, but gaining autonomy, running longer tasks, and beginning to transact. 

x402 and protocols like it exist because agents need to move money at machine speed.

But at machine speed, things we treat as fixed start breaking apart. 

Politics doesnt work because it moves faster than we can regulate. Faster than we can even understand. The financial economy takes on a velocity we’ve never had. Billions of economic agents will be doing things we don’t even see. 

Gone are the days of websites and front ends... what’s coming is machine readable, made for machines, by machines. An invisible economy at a scale vaster than we can comprehend.

Thats what my Economic Singularity framework describes. The point where the economy starts moving beyond human speed and human comprehension, and the old ways of running the world stop working.

此前消息：8月29日，与特朗普品牌相关的实体纪念币账号 @realtrumpcoins1（特朗普 @realDonaldTrump  官方账号曾关注）突然在 X 上宣传 Solana 链代币 Trump Digital Gold（ $GOLD ），并引导用户前往 https://t.co/dX1tNi59Xg 购买。

该账号此前主营特朗普主题实体纪念币，并非加密项目方。受“特朗普关联账号发币”叙事带动， $GOLD 上线后市值一度冲至约 5000万至6600万美元。

链上数据显示，开发者及一批新创建钱包合计控制约 82% 供应量。随后相关钱包抛售筹码，代币价格迅速崩盘，市值跌至约 50万至60万美元，较高点下跌约 99%。账号随后删除发币及“请投资并持有”等相关推文。

市场对此存在两种解读：
一种认为账号或网站遭到劫持，被用于引流发盘；
另一种认为属借品牌信任度进行的典型控盘砸盘。无论哪种情形，代币本身筹码高度集中、上线后迅速出货的结构，已符合土狗收割特征

Robinhood链上meme代币 solana:61Wj56QgGyyB966T7YsMzEAKRLcMvJpDbPzjkrCZc4Bi 市值突破20M，持仓榜一him @himgajria ：将效仿 $ANSEM 代币模式，对社区进行手动空投

8 月 29 日，Robinhood 链 meme 币 COPPERINU 主要推动人 him 表示，将效仿 ANSEM 代币的模式，对社区进行手动空投。「到最后，我将分发掉几乎所有的我的供应量。」

solana:61Wj56QgGyyB966T7YsMzEAKRLcMvJpDbPzjkrCZc4Bi 代币今晚市值速通 20M ，现报19.5M

此前消息：该代币开发者将 40% 代币转至加密 KOL him 钱包。him 随后公开表示，愿意将该代币开发成带有质押、申领、销毁功能的代币，并愿意将这部分代币用于社区空投。

COPPERINU 梗灵感来自今年 1 月加密 KOL Cobie @cobie   的一条推文。Cobie 开玩笑说交易真实大宗商品（铜）不用担心「Copper Inu」会抢走注意力，也不会有人在 https://t.co/iTQE8daAmX 上不断发新「铜产品」。加密 KOL him 曾主导当时在 SOL 上的 meme 币 COPPERINU 传播，被社区视为该题材的「顶流持有者」和主要叙事推动者。

📉Meme币GOLD宣发推文遭删除，币价「归零」

8 月 29 日，Meme 币 $GOLD 初始宣发推文遭删除，代币市值跌至 60 万美元。realtrumpcoins @realtrumpcoins1  官推发文称，「至处理情况，请投资和待命。」随后，此条推文也被删除，目前 realtrumpcoins 官推所有关于 Meme 币 GOLD 的内容均全部被删除，疑似官推夺回控制权。

⚠️社群成员提醒此项目与网站/链接看似关联也不等于官方确认，并引用 Eric Trump @EricTrump 此前「没有人在发币，否则就是欺诈」的表态，呼吁先等明确背书再行动。中文社区及多语社群普遍提醒「别盲目 FOMO」「等确认再考虑」。
